tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Identification of AvBDs and cathepsins in protein extracts from intestinal segments analysed by bottom-up mass spectrometry (nanoLC-MS/MS).
footnotes: b To, caecal tonsils; C, caecum; I, ileum; J, jejunum.
c Exponentially modified protein abundance index.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Characterization of AvBDs peptidoforms from bone marrow peptide extract by top-down mass spectrometry.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Antimicrobial activities of AvBD7 and of Ile4-AvBD7.
footnotes: a Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) values were determined by a radial diffusion assay for every bacterial strain. Values are given in μM as means +/- SEM indicated in parenthesis (n = 3). NI: no inhibition detected.

tables.caption: NMR constraints and structural statistics.
footnotes: b Values are given as mean ± standard deviation (n = 10).
